title: Creating Illustrated Typography
slide_intent: Balance expressive distortion with legibility so a reader can enjoy the food character without losing the words.
strategic_value: A shared construction method and limited flourishes can keep locally produced Burger King lettering coherent.
demonstration: A left rule column accompanies three Round, Square and Rectangular workflow columns, combining effect-dialog screenshots with numbered before/after lettering examples.
practical_value: Choose the workflow for the package shape, then adjust the letterforms by hand while respecting the word, color and flourish limits.

content_islands.name: Construction rules
content_islands.spec: Place the explanation, five limits and three numbered hand-adjustment goals at left.

content_islands.name: Round workflow
content_islands.spec: Show Arc Upper/Lower and Inflate examples followed by a hand-adjusted circular result.

content_islands.name: Square workflow
content_islands.spec: Show Free Distort and slight Twist examples leading to the square lettering result.

content_islands.name: Rectangular workflow
content_islands.spec: Show Free Distort and slight Wave examples leading to the wide result; retain the local-approval note below.

reference_purposes.Intent: The copy says the lettering should illustrate its descriptive words and warns that excessive movement causes legibility issues.
reference_purposes.Application: The three columns teach Illustrator effects followed by hand adjustment for round, square and rectangular formats.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The page limits each format to two words and one flourish or ligature, requires legible forms and one color per word, and requires Global Design Team approval for local versions.

ingredient.name: Illustrated-type construction
ingredient.role: Shape readable words to express food qualities and fill packaging.
ingredient.application: Use no more than two words per format, one color per word and one flourish or ligature per format. Keep every letter legible, fit the space, and refine effect-generated forms by hand.
ingredient.scope: Historical partner guide. Round uses Arc Upper/Lower then Inflate; square uses Free Distort then slight Twist; rectangular uses Free Distort then slight Wave. Local versions require BK Global Design Team approval.
